video_title: Jalen Brunson and Karl-Anthony Towns on the Knicks being up 2-0 in the NBA Finals 🔥 | NBA on ESPN

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson and Karl-Anthony Towns on their second quarter defensive performance
quotes.excerpt: we were just reading and reacting and we were playing off each other.

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Brunson
text_blocks.text: We were just reading and reacting and we were playing off each other. Saw the same thing you did.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the team's composure during high-pressure playoff moments
quotes.excerpt: It's a credit to the character that this team has. Not being able to fold in situations.
quotes.quote: We had to do a good job of staying composed in those situations. It's a credit to the character that this team has. Not being able to fold in situations like that is key to winning games like this. At this stage of the season, things aren't going to be pretty. It's going to be ugly, it's going to be grinded out. It's as simple as that. No matter what the situation is, we're going to have each other's back.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the trust and work ethic of his teammates
quotes.excerpt: I have the utmost trust and faith in them just because of their work ethic.
quotes.quote: That's just who they are. That's who my teammates are. Night in and night out, they come and bring it. There's always going to be things said regardless of the situation, but I have the utmost trust and faith in them just because of their work ethic and the things that we're able to do every day. When there's no cameras and we're in the practice gym, when we're in film, when we're trying to be the best team we can be, that's when in those moments, that's when we grow.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on the team's successful 2-0 start in the Finals
quotes.excerpt: It's a testament to the coaches getting us a great game plan and to my teammates executing.
quotes.quote: It's all about the team success. For us to be up 2-0, it's a testament to the coaches getting us a great game plan and to my teammates executing the game plan. It's a team effort and we found a way to win these two games, so it's a shout out to everyone coming together for the greater cause.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the team's reliance on experience and execution
quotes.excerpt: We keep leaning on experience and we keep leaning on the work execution.
quotes.quote: I have been on the other side where you're a young team and you're trying to do a lot to win the game. For us, we keep leaning on experience and we keep leaning on the work execution. I think we did a good job when we needed to executing, but we didn't do as well as we want to. When we get back to New York, we'll get back to work, we'll get back to the gym and try to correct the mistakes we made tonight.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the necessity of being prepared for 48 minutes
quotes.excerpt: No matter what goes on throughout a game, just having each other's back for 48 minutes is important.
quotes.quote: Knowing them, there's definitely not a level. We got to be prepared and we got to be ready to match it and be ready to play for 48 minutes. No matter what goes on throughout a game, just having each other's back regardless of what's going on, who's on a run, who's not, who's up, who's down, just making sure that we're playing together for 48 minutes is really important.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the team's zero-zero mindset despite the series lead
quotes.excerpt: Our mindset was zero-zero, not being up 1-0. Next game has the mindset to be zero-zero again.
quotes.quote: Every single day, we chip away trying to be the best team we can be. I think our mindset was zero-zero, not being up 1-0. Even with the what the series is now, next game has the mindset to be zero-zero again. It's how it has to be. You can't be comfortable, you can't be satisfied with anything. You just got to continue to push forward.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on Mitchell Robinson's defensive impact and resilience
quotes.excerpt: Mitchell Robinson is a hell of a defensive player and you expect him to make the best effort.
quotes.quote: I feel like that last play was the culmination of the game. Just downloading information as the game went along, guarding Wembanyama throughout the game and I think at the last possession it was the best defense he's played on him all day. Mitchell Robinson is a hell of a defensive player and you expect him to make the best effort defensively. It just speaks to his resiliency too, going out here playing with the injury and coming up with the biggest play of the game. It just speaks to how important he is to our team and the impact he has on our team. He's one of a kind.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on Karl-Anthony Towns's phenomenal two-way play
quotes.excerpt: He's been pretty phenomenal on both sides of the ball.
quotes.quote: He's been great. He's been pretty phenomenal on both sides of the ball and the things he's been able to do throughout this entire playoffs, but obviously here now, it's been great, but we need more.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the team's collective resilience and trust
quotes.excerpt: This team doesn't disband, they don't go away from each other. We lean into each other.
quotes.quote: This team doesn't disband, they don't go away from each other. We lean into each other even more. We trust each other even more to get out of the rut. It's what special teams do. The success I did have in my career has always come down to one thing and it's been the unity of the team. How well does that team really truly enjoy being in each other's presence, because the NBA season is a grind and you're going to be with each other more than you're going to be with your families, your kids. If you guys don't truly enjoy the grind and the work that needs to be put in together, I don't think success is possible. So it's a testament to these guys. That's where the resiliency comes from that we don't want to let each other down. We do look at each other as family, as brothers, and we don't ever want to see each other not succeed.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on his focus on team success over individual stats
quotes.excerpt: I'm just happy to be finding ways to win. I'm just worried about the team result.
quotes.quote: For me, I'm just happy to be finding ways to win with Jalen and everybody. I'm just worried about the team result, which is winning.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on Jalen Brunson's clutch performance and leadership
quotes.excerpt: I see Captain Clutch doing what he's always been doing since I got here.
quotes.quote: I see Captain Clutch doing what he's always been doing since I got here. He's a huge part when it comes to the actual game, to winning the game. Number 11 can't be messed with.

quotes.speaker: Mike Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Brown on the back-and-forth nature of the game
quotes.excerpt: They made a run, we made a run, they made a run, we made a run.
quotes.quote: They made a run, we made a run, they made a run, we made a run. So there was a lot of back and forth throughout the course of the game. Obviously, they made their run towards the end and you know, we could have folded a few times, but our guys just kept fighting. They kept fighting and the one thing I told them that you work on connectivity throughout the course of the year for moments like these.

quotes.speaker: Mike Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Brown on Victor Wembanyama's iconic status
quotes.excerpt: Wembanyama is, I said it before, he's iconic. There's nobody like him.
quotes.quote: Wembanyama is, I said it before, he's iconic. There's nobody like him. He can score from all three levels. He wants the ball and two big possessions at the end of the game, we put Mitch on him. And what I'm proud about more than anything else is, Mitch defended him the right way.

quotes.speaker: Mike Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Brown on the team's defensive strategy against Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: Wembanyama's iconic. If he makes the shot, he makes the shot. You're not blocking a shot.
quotes.quote: Wembanyama's iconic. If he makes the shot, he makes the shot. You're not blocking a shot. But you make him work, you lead with your chest, you show your hands, and you embrace those details while trying to guard him and then box out. It started with Mitch and it ended with the other four guys boxing out. So just a heck of a job by Mitch guarding the most iconic player in the world on two possessions to possibly win the game.

quotes.speaker: Mike Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Brown on the team's mental toughness and resilience
quotes.excerpt: It's an amazing feeling as a coach to know how mentally tough your team is.
quotes.quote: It's an amazing feeling as a coach to know how mentally tough your team is, no matter what the situation is in front of them. To see them continue to fight and fight and fight and fight, no matter what the score is, no matter how much time's on the clock, it's just a fantastic feeling.

quotes.speaker: Mike Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Brown on Mitchell Robinson's composure and discipline
quotes.excerpt: He doesn't seem like he ever gets too high, doesn't seem like he ever gets too low.
quotes.quote: He doesn't seem like he ever gets too high, doesn't seem like he ever gets too low. We play him for 30 seconds and pull him out. We play him for seven minutes and pull him out and he's the same all the time. He just went and did his job.

quotes.speaker: Mike Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Brown on the trust and collaboration within his coaching staff
quotes.excerpt: I got great assistants, even the guys sitting behind the bench, my young guys.
quotes.quote: Jordan, you know, he's been a master at this. I got great assistants, even the guys sitting behind the bench, my young guys. I'm scared to death that one of these teams are going to poach my guys. I'm surprised nobody's come at Chris Jent for a head job yet. The guy's won Summer League as a coach, he's a lead assistant here. I can go down the line talking about all my guys.

quotes.speaker: Mike Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Brown on Karl-Anthony Towns's complete basketball performance
quotes.excerpt: Two games Karl-Anthony Towns has played as complete a basketball games as you've seen him play.
quotes.quote: Two games Karl-Anthony Towns has played as complete a basketball games as you've seen him play probably this season. It's supposed to be like it is. He's a great player. I come in with a plan, maybe the plan doesn't work. Who adjusts, him or me? Me. I adjust.

quotes.speaker: Mike Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Brown on the team's accountability and trust
quotes.excerpt: The fact that none of them are afraid to come look me in my eye is huge.
quotes.quote: The connectivity that we all have, the trust that we all have, but more importantly, the fact that none of them are afraid to come look me in my eye and tell me what I need to do better by holding me accountable is huge.
